name: DanaMakmur Investama
description: Investing in Indonesia's future, one race at a time.
story: DanaMakmur Investama is a leading Indonesian investment firm focused on supporting growth industries within the country. Seeing the rising popularity and professionalization of motorsport, they view sponsorship as a way to connect with a younger, aspirational demographic. They aim to cultivate brand awareness and associate themselves with high performance and technological advancement.
